success_patterns: Compound requests are decomposed into distinct documented deliverables, with each mapped to the endpoint that performs it.
Shared identifiers and requested constraints are carried to the relevant calls, while separate targets or markets receive separate calls.
Independent required calls are issued together without adding unrelated or merely adjacent endpoints.

patch.reasoning: These recurring behaviors are already covered by the skill’s endpoint-mapping, scoping, and independent-call rules. Other discrepancies are isolated or concern defaults and representations already addressed by existing guidance, so no new patch is warranted.
